verses.24:49: وَإِن يَكُن لَّهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ يَأۡتُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ مُذۡعِنِينَ

meaning: The root ذعن (dhEn) primarily means quick obedience, acknowledgment, and submission. It implies being tractable and humble, readily complying with what is due.
en_note: Statistically derived from translation co-occurrence, not a lexical definition. Highlighting only.
